Pure Financial Advisors Holds Holding in Apple (AAPL); Swedbank Has Cut Its Stake in Pioneer Natural (PXD) as Stock Value Rose 
April 23, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Swedbank decreased its stake in Pioneer Natural (PXD) by 4.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Swedbank sold 79,740 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.72 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $296.89 million, down from 1.80M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Swedbank who had been investing in Pioneer Natural for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $33.59 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $2.02 during the last trading session, reaching $196.97. About 888,271 shares traded. Pioneer Natural Resources Company (NYSE:PXD) has declined 4.79% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.34% the S&P500. 
Pure Financial Advisors Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 18.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pure Financial Advisors Inc bought 3,130 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 20,421 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.46M, up from 17,291 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
